_readme: Things Exiled has told Ravyn about his own League account.
THIS IS NOT GAME KNOWLEDGE. STATUS.md §7 governing principle: she may only
assert things you told her, or things the API measured — never anything she
would have to know about League. Everything in this file is the first kind.
It reaches the prompt under a heading that says so, kept separate from the
measured SITUATION block, so she can never present your opinion as a fact
the game gave her.
That also means: write it in YOUR voice, as claims about YOURSELF. 'I never
win this lane' is yours to say. 'Riven loses to Garen' is a claim about the
game and does not belong here.
THE FILE IS NEVER FINISHED AND NEVER NEEDS TO BE. Five role entries and a
handful of champions is a working file. Untagged champions fall back to
role-only commentary; unknown roles fall back to champion-only. Nothing
breaks when something is missing — the line just does not fire.
Champion keys are matched loosely: case, spaces and punctuation are ignored,
so 'Lee Sin', 'leesin' and 'LeeSin' are the same key. Wukong is 'MonkeyKing'
in the API; either spelling works here.
EVERY VALUE BELOW IS A PLACEHOLDER taken from the §7 sketch. Overwrite them.
They are the shape, not your actual account.
Any value still containing the word PLACEHOLDER is IGNORED — it never
reaches the model, and the angle that would have used it does not fire.
The startup log says how many are still waiting. This is deliberate: on
the first live run the example text went straight to the LLM and she
opened a game trying to make sense of the word PLACEHOLDER out loud.
